meta.title: VMS / VRP Import: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Open or locate the VMS / VRP Import capability.
Verify that Growth-plan tenants hide or refuse the import.
Verify that Enterprise-plan tenants allow the same import.
Compare the same implementation-partner role and steps across two plan configurations.
